injector.title: Injector
injector.subtitle: Connects to an external TCP system and sends ISO 8583 messages
injector.noResponses: No responses yet. Configure host/port and inject a message.
injector.varyIdentifiersHelpBody:
On each send, the following fields are refreshed automatically in the message:

• Bit 7 — Transmission DateTime: current date/time
• Bit 11 — STAN: incremented on each send
• Bit 12 — Local Time: current time
• Bit 13 — Local Date: current date
• Bit 37 — RRN: randomly generated

Recommended for continuous mode — prevents the authorizer from rejecting messages as duplicates.
injector.varyAmountHelpBody:
When enabled, Bit 4 (Amount) gets a random value between the configured minimum and maximum on each send.

Useful for simulating real transactional traffic with varied amounts.
injector.amountRangeInvalid: Min must be positive and less than max.
